lead_raw_text:
The orthorhombic Tb4Ni2C6 structure (reduced formula Tb2NiC3) crystallizes in space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 12 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Ni in a trigonal-bipyramidal environment of five C neighbors, while C adopts two distinct 6-coordinate environments and Tb is 9-coordinate to C. The periodic neighbor graph is fully 3-dimensional. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reports corner- and edge-sharing between Ni trigonal bipyramids, plus corner- and edge-sharing between C-centered 6-vertex polyhedra.
